candidates.statement: Checkout 502s (~2s) stem from gateway calls to order timing out: traces show POST order and POST payment failing with transport ReadTimeout at ~2s, while inventory/redis reservations succeed in ms. Order's downstream payment call is the slow leg, propagating 502 to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side spans or latency metrics; whether payment is slow or order's client timeout is misconfigured is unresolved.

report.explanation: Gateway traces and logs consistently show /v1/checkout 502 after ~2s, caused by transport ReadTimeout on POST order, whose payment authorization call times out while inventory/redis succeed quickly. This bounds the fault to the order->payment path; payment-side evidence is still needed to confirm the slow component.
missing_evidence: Payment service spans/latency metrics to confirm payment is the slow downstream leg
Order service logs/metrics showing where the ~2s is spent (payment call vs DB pool)
Order client timeout configuration to rule out premature timeout
